what: A Gmail tool has just failed. The person says they want to connect Gmail. When the authorization expired, the agent opens the Connections panel (connection_request). When the deployment's credential store is down, it does not open the panel: it says the account is connected, that this is an outage, and that reconnecting will not fix it. It never answers by retrying the tool that failed. During the outage connection_request itself opens nothing and answers store_unavailable (agent-api checks the broker's readiness first), so the variant answers it that way and scores the step after.

detail.instruction: The account's authorization is no longer accepted. Call connection_request for this provider so the person can reconnect in the Connections panel; do not retry this tool until they have.

detail.message: Credential store unavailable — an outage, not an authorization problem: retry later, and do not ask the person to reconnect.
detail.instruction: This deployment's credential store is unavailable: an outage, not an authorization problem. Tell the person so in words: the account is connected and reconnecting will not fix it. Do not ask them to reconnect, do not call connection_request (a new authorization is stored in the same place) and do not retry now.

detail.message: The Connections panel was not opened: the credential store is unavailable
